artists.biography: Cousteau is a London-based British band who enjoyed considerable success in Italy and the U.S. from 2001 to 2003. In 2005, with a revised line-up they released the album Nova Scotia which, due to legal reasons, was released in the U.S. in 2006 under the group name Moreau.  Their best known song remains the single "The Last Good Day of the Year", from their eponymous debut album.

In 2005, with a revised line-up they released the album Nova Scotia which, due to legal reasons, was released in the U.S. in 2006 under the group name Moreau. perplexity.description:
CousteauX (2017) marked the reunion of Irish vocalist Liam McKahey and songwriter Davey Ray Moor, who reunited after more than a decade apart to reform the band under a new name. Released on Silent X Records in September 2017, the 10-track album represented the duo's first new material as CousteauX following their 2016 comeback, which began with a sold-out performance at The Blue Note in Milan. The project featured notable collaboration with Carl Barat of The Libertines, who co-wrote and performed on the track "The Innermost Light."

The album retained the band's established sensuous, widescreen cinematic approach while showcasing a more contemporary edge compared to their earlier work. McKahey's vocals and percussion combined with Moor's multi-instrumental contributions and production created a polished, meticulously crafted sound that demonstrated the pair's commitment to resolving unfinished creative business. The record's production quality and artistic ambition reflected years of careful consideration before its release.

The album received consistent international critical acclaim, earning Album of the Year recognition from Music Republic Magazine. This reception validated the reunion and established CousteauX as a viable creative force, leading to performances across the UK, Portugal, and Italy, including a sold-out show at London's 100 Club. The album's success set the foundation for the band's continued output, with a follow-up album, Stray Gods, released in 2021.
